then.text: Go on, off you go. Have a bowl of something warm. A proper stew, not a Dublin Bay prawn in a fancy glass. I'm not a doctor.

else.text: Ah, the lad off the boat! Or the lass! Or the person with a very good ticket!
Fáilte! Welcome to Dublin. You came all the way over on the boat for this? Fair play to you.
Kin creatures are the everyday ones. Hares, cattle, ponies. Everyday doesn't mean easy. Let's go!
The Kin Stone. Cattle, ponies, hares, the lot. Everyday creatures with an everyday kind of strength. It's the strength of a good neighbour.
No new field tricks with it, mind. It just means every field in Ireland will wave at you. I've found it quite useful.
Your phone buzzes. Professor Garside, who is speaking with her mouth full.
{player}! The Kin Stone! Six! I'm eating a custard cream in your honour. The Irish stones are singing a lovely slow air.
The Enclosure's Irish admin is a Director Kerrigan. She sounds terribly sensible on the phone, which I find sinister.
Take the Wicklow road south, then Kilkenny. I'm told the castle has the best chips in the south-east. Not that I read about that.
Outside, the Wardens on the Wicklow road quietly stored their tarmac samples and pretended they'd been testing the surface.
